'''CT-5/501''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] stationed on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], along with [[CT-4/619]], of a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] while attempting to capture [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]], but ended up rescuing Raxus Prime "orphan" [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. He then flew to the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]''.
